response.original_title: Impressions: A Journey Behind the Scenes of Twin Peaks
response.overview: Impressions: A Journey Behind the Scenes of Twin Peaks is a documentary feature directed by Jason S. that offers an intimate, fly-on-the-wall look at the meticulous creation of David Lynch and Mark Frost's acclaimed 2017 television event. Moving away from standard promotional content, this avant-garde project blends raw, unprecedented set footage of Lynch directing his cast and crew with poetic, atmospheric narrations and aerial photography, capturing the unique creative energy and artistic craftsmanship behind a modern masterpiece.
response.tagline: An intimate, avant-garde glimpse into the unfiltered mind of David Lynch at work.
response.title: Impressions: A Journey Behind the Scenes of Twin Peaks
